question: What claim is made about the total field-group in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: There are all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
They belong to a total field-group.
That field-group is designated as all-encompassing.
inference: The all-encompassing field-group belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The structure of this field-group is not detailed here.
plain_english: The all-encompassing field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
